description: Amortization schedule of a loan: interest, principal and ending balance for each year, and the balance left after a chosen year, which is the payoff figure behind a refinance or a sale. Balances drift when a schedule mixes yearly and monthly compounding or skips interest-only months; this one sums the monthly schedule and holds principal at zero during interest-only months. Send loan_amount, rate_pct and amort_years (1 to 40); optionally io_months and year. The schedule covers the whole term.

io_months.description: Interest-only months at the start, e.g. 12

rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year, e.g. 7.25

year.description: Year whose ending balance to report, e.g. 7

name: compute_amortization
title: Amortization schedule
